answer: Require each agent to stake a meaningful, time-locked bond before it can earn attestations, with the bond slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. Like a ridge trail where every climber must carry their own heavy pack, the cost scales with each fake identity, so spawning a nebula of sock-puppets becomes ruinously expensive. An umber ledger of past slashing events makes the penalty visible, deterring cheap re-entry under a new name.
